title: Richard Feynman: Magnets and Why Questions
summary: A clip from a BBC interview in which Richard Feynman is asked why magnets repel and attract. He explains that "why" questions depend on what a person already accepts as fundamental.
why: Cited whenever a discussion turns to how hard it is to answer "why" questions or what counts as an explanation.

quote.text: Feynman, of course, has a pretty definitive response on the difficulty of this problem
